name: Roast Turkey
source: host-supplied: How to cook turkey in a conventional oven
serves: unknown - the source gives times by weight and no size for a headcount

ingredients.whole_turkey_lbs: chosen by the cook from the weight bands below
ingredients.vegetable_oil_or_melted_butter: to brush the breast, quantity not stated
ingredients.aluminum_foil: a loose tent for the breast once it is golden

notes: 325F. Times by weight: 6-8 lb 2 1/4-2 3/4 h; 8-12 lb 2 3/4-3 h; 12-14 lb 3-3 3/4 h; 14-18 lb 3 3/4-4 1/4 h; 18-20 lb 4 1/4-4 1/2 h; 20-24 lb 4 1/2-5 h; 24-28 lb 5-5 1/2 h. Breast-side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan, brushed with vegetable oil or melted butter; tent loosely with foil once the breast is golden. Done at 165F in the thickest part of the breast away from the bone and in the thighs. Stand 10 minutes before slicing. Dairy-free only if oil is used rather than butter. The source gives no size for a headcount, no stuffing capacity and no temperature for stuffing in the cavity; its times are for an unstuffed bird.

name: Honey Spiral Sliced Bone-In Ham, Half
source: host direction, Carando honey spiral ham, about 10 lb half
serves: unknown - about 10 lb half ham, servings not stated

ingredients.swedish_mustard: to serve, quantity not stated - host confirms Swedish mustard, Slotts or IKEA

notes: Host directions: bring up to room temperature and serve. No cooking time or oven temperature given. It needs no oven, which matters on this menu because three other dishes already compete for one. Mustard is a declared allergen in some jurisdictions and honey mustard may also contain egg depending on the brand - check labels. No price is recorded in my files; costing is Procurement's.

name: Garlic Carrots Julienne
source: host file: Garlic Carrots Julienne.jpg (handwritten card, 8 servs.)
notes: Method as written: put carrots in a saucepan with the butter, water and garlic; cook covered in boiling water 5-10 minutes or until tender; drain well; season with salt and pepper; add more butter if desired. No prep time stated on the card.

name: Mimi's Turkey Stuffing
source: host file: Thanksgiving Recipes.pdf (scan, Mimi's Turkey Stuffing card)

ingredients.poultry_seasoning: 1/2 t, with '2 T.' written beside it on the card

notes: The card lists ingredients only: no method, oven temperature, bake time, yield or pan size, so it is not cookable as written. Written for stuffing a bird; host direction is to use it two ways, one batch inside the turkey and a second baked as a side. Marginal note in another hand reads 'Blarg' (uncertain reading). Poultry seasoning is the herb blend; no meat is listed, but the name and any pan juices are for Guest Manager to rule on.

name: Caramelized Pearl Onions with Orange Liqueur

ingredients.pearl_onions_lbs: 2-3 (stated as the amount for the whole Thanksgiving meal)

notes: Method as written: peel the onions, or buy them peeled; boil 5-10 minutes; drain and cool until dry and slightly sticky (peel when cool if they came with skins); saute in oil until browned and caramelized; add a pinch of salt, and a few teaspoons of water at a time if needed to dissolve the browning; off the heat add 1-2 tbsp liqueur per pound and flambé. Frozen onions work: defrost and pat dry, no boiling. No serves stated; the source gives 2-3 lb for the whole meal. Gluten-free status of the liqueur not stated.

name: Fresh Cranberry Orange Relish
source: host file: Fresh Cranberry Orange Relish.pdf

ingredients.orange_each: 1, unpeeled, cut into eighths and seeded
ingredients.cranberries_packages_12oz: 1, Ocean Spray fresh or frozen, rinsed and drained

notes: Process half the cranberries and half the orange in a food processor until evenly chopped, transfer to a bowl, repeat with the rest, then stir in the sugar. Keeps in the fridge or freezer. Makes about 3 cups; the source's nutrition is per 1/4 cup, and it marks the recipe GF, DF, V, VG, LF, LS, K. No headcount stated. A food grinder also works.

name: Fresh Cranberry Sauce
notes: Boil sugar and water, add the cranberries and return to the boil, then boil gently 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cover and cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate until serving. 5 minutes prep plus 15 minutes cooking and cooling. Makes 2 1/4 cups; the source's nutrition is per 2 tablespoons and it marks the recipe GF, DF, V, VG, LF, LS, K. No headcount stated.

name: Corn Pudding with Chives
notes: Bake at 350F for 1 hour or until a knife inserted in the centre comes out clean. Source post dated 2008-11-20. Yield not stated. Corn may be 8 fresh ears, or canned, or frozen/thawed; 1/3 cup chives listed as fresh chopped, source notes dried is usually what they use.

name: Green Bean Casserole

ingredients.crispy_fried_onions_cups: 2 2/3, divided (1 1/3 in the mix, 1 1/3 on top)

notes: Cook 30 minutes: bake uncovered at 350F for 25 minutes until hot and bubbling, stir, scatter the remaining onions, bake 5 minutes more until golden. Source recipe names specific brands and a 3-qt baking dish. Gluten and soy come from the soy sauce and the fried onions; verify labels and cross-contact before asserting anything allergy-safe.

name: Sweet Potato Casserole with Marshmallows
notes: Yield 1 x 9x13-inch casserole, 8 servings. 350F. Boil the sliced sweet potatoes in water to cover until a fork pierces easily, about 15 minutes; drain and mash. Beat with the brown sugar, butter, orange juice and cinnamon until smooth. Spread in the 9x13 dish, scatter the marshmallows over the top, bake 25-30 minutes until hot and the marshmallows are puffed and golden, watching closely at the end so they do not scorch. Stand a few minutes before serving. Total time about 1 hour. Marshmallows normally contain gelatin, so this is not vegetarian unless the pack says otherwise - verify the label.

name: Mashed Potatoes
serves: unknown - 5 lb of russets, servings not stated
notes: Host method: boil the potatoes, then mash, then add 2 sticks of unsalted butter and about 1 cup of light cream or whole milk, and pepper to taste. No salt is listed; no boil time, no yield and no oven step. Vegetarian, contains dairy, not vegan. Wants making close to service and holding warm, so it belongs at the end of the hob queue.

name: Pumpkin Ice Cream Pie
source: host file: Thanksgiving Recipes.pdf (scan, card attributed to Judy Gumby)

ingredients.vanilla_ice_cream: 1/2 layer in the bottom of the shell, quantity not stated

notes: Method as written: spread a 1/2 layer of vanilla ice cream in the bottom of one baked pie shell; mix the pumpkin, sugar, nutmeg, ginger and salt; whip the cream and fold it into the pumpkin mixture; pour into the shell; freeze at least 5 hours. No serves, pan size or prep time stated. Gluten comes from the pie shell.
